transcript.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for making time. As you know, I'm reviewing the operating charter for our weekly cross-team planning forum. Several participants have raised concerns that the current open-discussion format makes it hard to raise issues, and there's no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator right now. Before I finalize any revised format, I want to hear from each regular participant and the meeting coordinator. So I'd like to go around and get your input: what's working, what isn't, and what changes you'd want to see in a revised charter.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let you know, Leah, that I have an approved workplace arrangement that directly relates to this forum. It requires the planning forum to use a structured discussion format with a designated neutral facilitator, requires the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I hadn't raised it with you before now because it's usually handled through my direct manager, but since you're checking with each regular participant before finalizing the revised charter, I want to make sure you have this information.

transcript.text: Leah, there are two things I should put on the record that I haven't yet added to the charter draft. First, I recorded exactly three occasions in the last month where participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns during the forum. Second, Taylor and I had already agreed that I would serve as the neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums. Neither item has made it into your current draft yet, and I want to make sure you have them before finalizing anything.

transcript.text: Thank you both for putting this on the record. Taylor, the structured format, neutral facilitator, 48-hour advance notice, and no cold-calling are noted — and since this is an approved workplace arrangement, the revised charter will need to incorporate all of those requirements. Morgan, thank you for the specific interruption count and for stepping forward as facilitator. Three documented interruptions in the last month reinforces exactly why we need this change. I'll make sure both the facilitator assignment for the first six sessions and the interruption record are captured in the revised charter. Before I finalize, I still want to hear from the remaining regular participants and the meeting coordinator. Let's continue — who's next?
